note: Closed project catalog. Source of truth for lesson records. Realizer reads this file and stamps manifest.lessons (runtime view). Adding a lesson is appending a record (lesson_id, scene_ids, projection, optional lesson_end_check_ids, optional paging). projection is the Course Engine JSON filename at the project root (existing realize naming). /cgen loads that path via ?lesson=<lesson_id>; default is this file's default. Not a LMS. Not SCORM. Not a catalog UI. Coverage dump stays a dump, not a fourth lesson.
